answers.title: Research early
answers.detail: Talk to seniors about the city, campus and housing. Listen to real experiences.

answers.title: A fixed daily call time
answers.detail: Talk every day at a set time. Half the worry at home goes away.

answers.title: Emergency plan ready
answers.detail: Local emergency number, university contact and a friend's number. On your phone and on paper.
